```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(plotly)
library(dygraphs)
library(xts)
library(tsibble)
library(feasts)
library(fabletools)
library(timetk)
library(anomalize)
library(slider)
library(DT)
library(leaflet)
library(denguedatahub)
```

```{r}
#| label: load-data
#| message: false
#| warning: false

data(srilanka_weekly_data)
```

```{r}
#| label: clean-data
#| message: false
#| warning: false

sl <- srilanka_weekly_data |>
  mutate(start.date = mdy(start.date)) |>
  arrange(district, start.date)

# All-island weekly totals
sl_total <- sl |>
  group_by(start.date) |>
  summarise(cases = sum(cases, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Annual totals by district
annual_district <- sl |>
  mutate(year = year(start.date)) |>
  group_by(district, year) |>
  summarise(annual_cases = sum(cases, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Top 10 districts by total cases
top10 <- annual_district |>
  group_by(district) |>
  summarise(total = sum(annual_cases), .groups = "drop") |>
  slice_max(total, n = 10) |>
  pull(district)

# Colombo for STL and anomaly
colombo <- sl |> filter(district == "Colombo")

colombo_ts <- colombo |>
  mutate(year_week = yearweek(start.date)) |>
  arrange(year_week) |>
  as_tsibble(index = year_week)

colombo_stl <- colombo_ts |>
  model(STL(cases ~ season(period = 52))) |>
  components()

# xts for dygraph
sl_xts <- xts(sl_total$cases, order.by = sl_total$start.date)

# District coordinates — names exactly match dataset
district_coords <- tibble(
  district = c("Colombo", "Gampaha", "Kalutara", "Kandy", "Matale",
               "NuwaraEliya", "Galle", "Matara", "Hambanthota",
               "Jaffna", "Kilinochchi", "Mannar", "Vavuniya", "Mullaitivu",
               "Batticaloa", "Ampara", "Kalmune", "Trincomalee",
               "Kurunegala", "Puttalam", "Anuradhapura", "Polonnaruwa",
               "Badulla", "Monaragala", "Ratnapura", "Kegalle"),
  lat = c(6.927, 7.084, 6.585, 7.291, 7.470,
          6.970, 6.054, 5.948, 6.124,
          9.661, 9.395, 8.978, 8.751, 9.267,
          7.717, 7.284, 7.414, 8.587,
          7.486, 8.036, 8.335, 7.939,
          6.989, 6.873, 6.680, 7.253),
  lon = c(79.861, 80.007, 79.960, 80.636, 80.624,
          80.783, 80.221, 80.536, 81.119,
          80.025, 80.399, 79.904, 80.497, 80.812,
          81.700, 81.672, 81.836, 81.234,
          80.362, 79.840, 80.406, 81.000,
          81.056, 81.349, 80.399, 80.349)
)

district_totals <- annual_district |>
  group_by(district) |>
  summarise(total_cases = sum(annual_cases), .groups = "drop")

map_data <- left_join(district_coords, district_totals, by = "district")

yearly_map_data <- left_join(district_coords, annual_district, by = "district")
```

## Row {height="80%"}

### Column {width="60%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Weekly Dengue Cases — All Sri Lanka"

dygraph(sl_xts) |>
  dyRangeSelector() |>
  dyOptions(
    strokeWidth = 1.5,
    fillGraph   = TRUE,
    fillAlpha   = 0.12,
    colors      = "#c0392b"
  ) |>
  dyHighlight(highlightSeriesOpts = list(strokeWidth = 2.5))
```

### Column {width="40%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Annual Cases by District (Top 10)"

p_top10 <- annual_district |>
  filter(district %in% top10) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = annual_cases,
             colour = district, group = district)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Paired") +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Annual Cases", colour = "District") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11)

ggplotly(p_top10)
```

# District Map

## Row {.tabset}

### Map by Year

```{r}
#| title: "Dengue Cases by District — Select Year"
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(crosstalk)
library(leaflet)

max_cases <- max(yearly_map_data$annual_cases, na.rm = TRUE)
pal <- colorNumeric(palette = "Reds", domain = c(0, max_cases))

years_list <- sort(unique(yearly_map_data$year))

# build one leaflet map per year, show first by default
# use leaflet with overlayGroups per year

m <- leaflet() |>
  addTiles() |>
  setView(lng = 80.7, lat = 7.8, zoom = 7)

for (yr in years_list) {
  d <- yearly_map_data |> filter(year == yr)
  m <- m |>
    addCircleMarkers(
      data        = d,
      lng         = ~lon,
      lat         = ~lat,
      radius      = ~pmax(sqrt(annual_cases) / 4, 3),
      color       = ~pal(annual_cases),
      fillColor   = ~pal(annual_cases),
      fillOpacity = 0.85,
      opacity     = 1,
      popup       = ~paste0("<b>District:</b> ", district,
                            "<br><b>Year:</b> ", year,
                            "<br><b>Cases:</b> ", format(annual_cases, big.mark = ",")),
      label       = ~district,
      group       = as.character(yr)
    )
}

m |>
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups   = as.character(years_list),
    options      = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    pal    = pal,
    values = c(0, max_cases),
    title  = "Annual Cases"
  )
```

### Cases by District

```{r}
#| title: "Annual Cases by District — Animated by Year"

yearly_map_data |>
  arrange(annual_cases) |>
  plot_ly(
    x           = ~annual_cases,
    y           = ~district,
    frame       = ~year,
    type        = "bar",
    orientation = "h",
    marker      = list(color = ~annual_cases, colorscale = "Reds"),
    text        = ~paste0("District: ", district,
                          "<br>Year: ", year,
                          "<br>Cases: ", format(annual_cases, big.mark = ",")),
    hoverinfo   = "text"
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis      = list(title = "Annual Cases", tickfont = list(size = 13)),
    yaxis      = list(
      title         = "",
      tickfont      = list(size = 13),
      categoryorder = "total ascending"
    ),
    margin     = list(l = 120, r = 20, t = 30, b = 50),
    showlegend = FALSE,
    height     = 600
  ) |>
  animation_opts(frame = 800, transition = 400) |>
  animation_slider(currentvalue = list(prefix = "Year: "))
```

# District Deep Dive

## Row {height="50%"}

### Column {width="50%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Weekly Cases — All Districts"

p_district_ts <- sl |>
  ggplot(aes(x = start.date, y = cases,
             colour = district,
             text = paste0("District: ", district,
                           "<br>Date: ", start.date,
                           "<br>Cases: ", cases))) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_colour_viridis_d(option = "turbo") +
  labs(x = "Date", y = "Cases", colour = "District") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10)

ggplotly(p_district_ts, tooltip = "text")
```

### Column {width="50%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Seasonal Pattern — All Districts"

p_seasonal_all <- sl |>
  mutate(
    week = isoweek(start.date),
    year = factor(year(start.date))
  ) |>
  group_by(district, week) |>
  summarise(cases = mean(cases), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = cases,
             colour = district,
             text = paste0("District: ", district,
                           "<br>Week: ", week,
                           "<br>Avg Cases: ", round(cases, 1)))) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_colour_viridis_d(option = "turbo") +
  labs(x = "Week of Year", y = "Average Cases", colour = "District") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10)

ggplotly(p_seasonal_all, tooltip = "text")
```

## Row {height="50%"}

### Column {width="50%"}

```{r}
#| title: "STL Decomposition — Colombo"

p_stl <- colombo_stl |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(year_week)) |>
  select(date, cases, trend, season_52, remainder) |>
  pivot_longer(-date, names_to = "component", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(component = factor(component,
    levels = c("cases", "trend", "season_52", "remainder"),
    labels = c("Observed", "Trend", "Seasonality", "Remainder"))) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = value)) +
  geom_line(colour = "#2c3e50", linewidth = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~component, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Cases") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

ggplotly(p_stl)
```

### Column {width="50%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Calendar Heatmap — Colombo"

p_heat <- colombo |>
  mutate(
    Year = factor(year(start.date)),
    Week = isoweek(start.date)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Week, y = Year, fill = cases)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "inferno", name = "Cases") +
  labs(x = "Week of Year", y = "Year") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10)

ggplotly(p_heat)
```

# Trend & Anomalies

## Row {height="50%"}

```{r}
#| title: "52-Week Rolling Mean — All Sri Lanka"

p_roll <- sl_total |>
  mutate(MA52 = slide_dbl(cases, mean, .before = 51, .complete = TRUE)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = start.date)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = cases), colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_line(aes(y = MA52), colour = "#c0392b", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(x = "Date", y = "Cases",
       caption = "Red = 52-week rolling mean | Grey = weekly observed") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11)

ggplotly(p_roll)
```

## Row {height="50%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Anomaly Detection — Colombo"
#| message: false
#| warning: false

colombo |>
  time_decompose(cases, method = "stl", frequency = 52, trend = 104) |>
  anomalize(remainder, method = "iqr") |>
  time_recompose() |>
  plot_anomalies(time_recomposed = TRUE, ncol = 1, alpha_dots = 0.5) +
  labs(x = "Date", y = "Cases") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11)
```
